title: Contract
description: A Quest Board contract (03-GAME-DESIGN §8.2; the table of 07-DUNGEONS.md §7): a templated daily or weekly condition the board fills with the player's band, paying gold in R and chest keys. One file per contract under content/contracts/<id>.json. Keys are capped per week by a rule, not here.

description.description: The condition as the board shows it ('kill 30 Vermin in the Cellars').

kind.description: The condition's shape: kill (count of a family, a monster or a boss), clear (reach a floor's stairs or clear it under a condition), light (a light threshold at the stairs or at a chest), noWipe (kills or a clear with no hero Fallen), collect (sell or carry an amount).

target.description: What the condition counts. Every key is optional; the linter checks the ones the kind needs: kill → count and one of familyId/monsterId; clear → floor or dungeonId; light → lightMin; collect → count.

monsterId.description: A specific monster (a hunter, a boss).

floor.description: A specific floor; omitted means any floor in the player's band.

lightMax.description: For 'while the light is Dark or Pitch': 25.

goldR.description: For collect: unbanked gold in R to return with.

condition.description: An arena or floor condition the sim checks by name ('tide-below-step-4', 'no-sealed-sarcophagus-opened').

goldR.description: Gold in units of R at the player's band.

keys.description: Chest keys: a Standard Key opens one Standard chest free, a Grand Key one Grand chest.

chestId.description: A chest given outright (the weekly's Material Crate); null for none.

items.description: Items given outright (Torches, a Skeleton Key).

band.description: The band the contract is written for (a weekly boss kill is band-specific); null for a template the board fills with the player's band.
